positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:

- Configure existing tools to import data from third party systems into ElasticSearch.
- Implemented Open Telemetry metrics to monitor performance of processes that fetch and process data for ingestion into ElasticSearch.
- Support the customer support team with complex problems related to fetching and ingesting data from third party systems.

- Uses AI tools to increase productivity.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented micro-services in Golang, including REST based services, PubSub message processors and Aggregator services to support a video surveillance platform.
- Designed and implemented shared middleware libraries using Prometheus and Open Telemetry
- Designed the reference implementation for Grafana boards for observability and alarms
- Advocated for the use of API contract based design between teams when developing new features
- Refactored the architecture to remove unneeded services and reduce hops between services
- Refactored critical services that use Google Cloud Platform PubSub and MQTT in an Event based sub-system
- Managed new work and tech debt for four micro-services and associated databases and infrastructure including managing the ClickUp board, code reviews, GitLab repo ownership, risk mitigation and deployment planning in a CI/CD environment
- Implemented a test framework for regression testing in an integrated environment 
- Wrote queries, and refactored queries for Postgres
- Advocated for the use of interface based design across the company to facilitate the use of GoMock for unit testing
- Worked with other teams to develop new features that spanned multiple services and the UI
Improved the performance of services to reduce the use of Redis caches
